test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Terry consumes 1700 mL of milk every day. How many litres of milk will she consume in 5 weeks?
solution:
**Given:**

Consumption of milk per day = 1700 mL

Total time = 5 weeks

**Concept Used:**

Conversion from mL to L

Conversion from weeks to days

Unitary method

**Calculation:**

**⇒** Milk consumption per day = 1700 ml = (1700)/(1000)=1.7 L

⇒ Milk consumed in 1 week = 1.7 × 7 = 11.9 L → (1 week = 7 days)

⇒ Milk consumed in 5 weeks = 11.9 × 5 = 59.5 L

**Therefore, 59.5 L of milk will be consumed by Terry in 5 weeks.**
